result:
I moved the success notification for the new comment edit feature out of the component and into the mutation hook. Components and routes no longer call `useNotifications` for this change. I did not run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/comments/api/update-comment.ts`**: `useUpdateComment` now calls `useNotifications` and shows the "Comment Updated" success notification in its `onSuccess`, next to the existing query invalidation. A caller's `mutationConfig.onSuccess` still runs after it.
- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx`**: removed the `useNotifications` import and the notification-only `mutationConfig`. The component now just calls `useUpdateComment({ discussionId })`.

The existing `create-comment.tsx`, `delete-comment.tsx` and the discussion and user components also call `useNotifications` directly. That was already the case before this change, so I left them alone. Say if you want them moved too.
